default.$description: Default page and app background. Put text and icons from surface/on-surface/* on it.

subtle.$description: Slightly recessed background for sidebars, section bands and table stripes. Use surface/on-surface/* for content.

muted.$description: Background for secondary containers such as input fields, code blocks and grouped content. Use surface/on-surface/* for content.

strong.$description: Strongest neutral background: skeleton loaders, slider and progress tracks, selected neutral rows. Use surface/on-surface/* for content.

inverse.$description: Inverted background (dark in Light mode, light in Dark mode) for tooltips, snackbars and inverse buttons. Use surface/on-surface/inverse for content and state/inverse/* for interaction states.

disabled.$description: Background for large disabled areas, such as a disabled input field. For disabled components (buttons, chips) use state/disabled.

overlay.$description: Background of overlay components: dialogs, side sheets, popovers and menus. Use surface/on-surface/* for content.

default.$description: Primary text and icons on surface/default, subtle, muted, strong and overlay backgrounds.

subtle.$description: Secondary text and icons (descriptions, captions, metadata) on surface backgrounds.

muted.$description: Placeholder and helper text on surface backgrounds.

disabled.$description: Text and icons of disabled elements, on surface backgrounds or on state/disabled.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on surface/inverse only.

brand.$description: Brand-coloured text and icons (highlights, prices) on surface backgrounds. Not for content on primary backgrounds — use primary/on-primary there.

default.$description: Main primary colour, used for primary actions: main buttons, active toggles, selected indicators. Use as background, icon or border colour. Text and icons on it: primary/on-primary.

lighter.$description: Lighter variant of primary/default (400 in Light, 600 in Dark). Use where a softer primary fill or stroke is needed next to the default. Text and icons on it: primary/on-primary.

darker.$description: Darker variant of primary/default (600 in Light, 400 in Dark). Use for primary text, borders or fills that need more emphasis than the default. Text and icons on it: primary/on-primary.

subtle.$description: Strongest faint primary tint. Background of selected or emphasised primary containers, e.g. a selected chip. Text and icons on it: primary/on-primary-subtle.

subtler.$description: Medium faint primary tint. Background of primary banners, alerts and tags. Text and icons on it: primary/on-primary-subtle.

subtlest.$description: Faintest primary tint. Background of large primary-tinted areas. Text and icons on it: primary/on-primary-subtle.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons placed only on primary/default, primary/lighter or primary/darker backgrounds.

on-primary-subtle.$description: Text and icons placed only on primary/subtle, primary/subtler or primary/subtlest backgrounds.

default.$description: Main accent/1 colour, used for secondary emphasis: secondary buttons, links, badges and highlights. Use as background, icon or border colour. Text and icons on it: accent/1/on-accent-1.

on-accent-1.$description: Text and icons placed only on accent/1/default, accent/1/lighter or accent/1/darker backgrounds.

overlay.$description: Layer opacity of the backdrop behind dialogs and side sheets.

none.$description: Spacing 0 — no gap or padding. Use for padding and gaps (auto layout).

xl.$description: Spacing 32px — section padding. Use for padding and gaps (auto layout).

sm.$description: Fixed width/height 20px — default icons in dense UI.

lg.$description: Fixed width/height 32px — small control height and small avatars.

square.$description: No rounding (0). Full-bleed images, tables and edge-to-edge sections.

subtle.$description: Subtle rounding (4px). Small controls: buttons, inputs, checkboxes and tags.

soft.$description: Soft rounding (8px). Cards, dropdown menus and tooltips.

rounded.$description: Rounded (16px). Large containers, panels and bottom sheets.

extra-rounded.$description: Extra rounded (24px). Overlay components: dialogs and side sheets (with surface/overlay).

pill.$description: Fully rounded. Pill buttons, chips, badges, avatars and toggles.

width.$description: Width (2px) of the keyboard focus ring. The same for every interactive component; use with the focus-ring colour.

offset.$description: Gap (2px) between a component and its focus ring. Figma can’t bind a variable to position, so in components the ring layer is placed this far outside the component; in code use it as outline-offset.
